title: Live Adjustments
description: Live adjustments for an MHD-tuned DME: switch engine maps 1-4 with the car standing still, MHD Max Cooling on (engine running) or off, and open or close the exhaust flap (BMW's own DME job; the DME takes control back after about 20 s). Map and cooling show what the DME accepted: MHD has no read-back.
